change_records.description: Readiness audit, phase plan status and Issue update
Execution contract, future-only PR template, phase evidence index, plan and Issue handoff

Pure playback queue validation, filtered queue index preservation, nonwrapping next, approved 3000ms previous semantics, seek clamping/overflow, 13 authored JUnit cases, two legacy assertion adjustments, 17-check reproducible script and P02 policy specification

Extract existing MediaStoreRefCodec without changing #6 behavior; implement injectable fail-closed service-compatible resolver, API 29–36 Android OS permission/volume/row/read-only FD probe, epoch invalidation and CancellationSignal; write 12 fake-probe JUnit tests and 17-check reproducible Kotlin-only smoke plus scoped source audit.

Implement queue-preflight to P03 resolver via narrow playback.api port and app.di composition root; atomic preparatory failure before single service Player setMediaItems; revision-guarded SelectQueueIndex, nonwrapping navigation, 256 completed replay window while preserving 32 waiting slots; 17 authored JUnit methods; fix ADR-0008 forbidden playback->data import without changing checker; exact blob pure Kotlin 367 smoke checks PASS.

Harden service-owned real Media3 prepare/play/stop/ended route and audio attributes, preserve true callback errors and queue revision, fix Library/Search visible ordered collection selection and selected-occurrence ACK, add 21 JUnit methods and repeatable 15-check pure Kotlin script

Construct session with ForwardingPlayer transport façade over same service ExoPlayer; allow only Play/Pause/Next/Previous/Seek/Stop to shared command worker, block external playlist URI/setMediaItems & repeat/shuffle/queue index; controller snapshot reconnect refresh/revision guard; local bounded MediaStore metadata to MediaItem on IO; 25 JUnit + 2 Android instrumentation test methods authored, exact-blob 16 pure Kotlin checks PASS.
change_records.final_fix: Explicit androidx.annotation.OptIn(UnstableApi) for Media3 1.5.1 ForwardingPlayer API

change_records.description: Implement real WF-06 FullPlayer with Play/Pause/Next/Previous/seek and live service-reported progress, lazy service queue item selection guarded by queue revision; CMP09 MiniPlayer for Library/Search, verified selection-only navigation, metadata presentation on IO and adaptive 150/200% font controls; one shared playback Gateway/VM, removed placeholder. All commits [skip ci]. No tests, Android build, Actions, PR or APK performed, as expressly requested by owner.

Media3 native FGS and notification preserved, explicit task removal policy retains real foreground-playing/buffering service only, controller-only Activity onStop unbind and foreground reattach, stopWithTask=false, 12 JUnit tests authored but NOT_RUN; no new Player, NotificationManager or POST_NOTIFICATIONS; all [skip ci], no tests/Actions/build/APK.

Media3 ExoPlayer.setHandleAudioBecomingNoisy(true), wake local, preexisting managed audio focus; Android AudioDeviceCallback sink loss fallback on service main; route epoch fences IO-suspended queue/index selection; manual Pause/Stop and reconnect require explicit new Play; 15 JUnit methods authored NOT_RUN; no Actions/test/build/APK. All changes [skip ci].

Categorize numeric Media3 playback IO/decoder exceptions and safe nested SecurityException/FileNotFoundException types; pause on error, attempt up to three subsequent MediaStore-revalidated queue occurrences with guarded queue/route/command generations, never auto-skip revoked permission, explicit Next and Play revalidation, truthful MediaSession state, accessible HF-06 recovery UI; 14 JUnit policy methods authored NOT_RUN; all GitHub commits [skip ci], no Actions/tests/build/APK.

Wire pre-existing app-owned Proto RestorableQueueStore to one MediaSessionService; serialize versioned limited metadata-free snapshots with atomic updateData and main-service 5s active checkpoint, immediate pause/queue/seek saves; cold restore reads before any write, prefers existing live session, superseded by commands/route; MediaStore revalidates and drops missing, clamps position to verified duration, restores strictly Paused with no Play; explicit Stop clears checkpoint; duplicate MediaRefs treated as positional occurrences. 29 new JUnit methods authored NOT_RUN, 22 static source-readback checks only; no Actions/Gradle/JVM/Android/phone/APK.
change_records.final_fix: Service remains sole checkpoint state producer; writes use existing application Main CoroutineScope so normal service teardown does not cancel final atomic store update, no separate audio authority

change_records.description: Six code integration corrections committed: manifest WAKE_LOCK required by Media3 local wake mode; command receipt epoch preempts stale IO queue/index/Play or decoder recovery; controller generation guards post-await stale UI snapshots and queue-appropriate bounded timeout; lazy controller bind only from Activity foreground avoids Application constructor DI race; nonfatal recovered media notice no longer suppresses background ongoing audio or 5s Proto checkpoint; conditional P10 recovery panel Queue shortcut correct. Authored 15 JVM source tests and 2 Android nonmutating service tests only. GitHub Actions/Gradle/JVM/Android/phone tests/builds executed: ZERO. One P13 cumulative APK pending authorized Android SDK environment.

Verified exact uploaded source RAR SHA and latest GitHub P00–P12 branch. The current execution sandbox has Java but NO Android SDK, android.jar, Gradle executable, full private-repository checkout or outbound DNS (curl and git ls-remote fail), so no valid APK can be built here. Created a deterministic Windows PowerShell build script that uses JDK17 + Android SDK36 + Gradle Wrapper to produce exactly one local P13 debug APK, SHA256 and source commit attestation, without GitHub Actions or tests. Marked P13 BLOCKED_BUILD_ENV; NO APK, NO test runs, NO PR/merge/close; all 13 AC unverified and 36 manual + 15 technical cases NOT_RUN.

Owner explicitly authorized GitHub Actions exclusively to assemble ONE cumulative P00-P12 debug APK without running tests. Isolated workflow issue-7-p13-apk-build-only.yml triggered by .github/issue7-p13-apk-request.txt; first run 39854155499 exposed a Kotlin Media3 AcceptedResultBuilder constructor compile error, which was fixed on feature branch. Second build-only run 39854659624 succeeded; 36,605,879-byte debug APK artifact 12458647942 with SHA256 verified against GitHub and downloaded APK. No JUnit, Android tests, emulator or lint. All 36 manual + 15 technical cases NOT_RUN; AC01-AC13 NOT_VERIFIED; no PR/merge/issue close.
